data.name: Mizanun
data.gender_notes: Mizanun is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Mizanun is an Arabic name for the One who embodies justice, fairness, and balance. Derived from the word Mizan, meaning scale, this name represents the idea of maintaining equilibrium in all aspects of life. The name Mizanun carries the meaning “Just, fair, balanced” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mizanun usually hope their child will grow to embody just, fair, balanced and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Mizanun is a name that resonates with the spiritual qualities of fairness, justice, and balance. It serves as a reminder to remain impartial and to uphold the principles of truth and righteousness.
data.etymology: Mizanun belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Just, fair, balanced.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mizanun total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: ميزانون
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من ميزان، يعني العدل والتوازن
in_arabic.long_meaning: الميزانون هو اسم مشتق من كلمة ميزان، وهي تعني العدل والتوازن. في اللغة العربية، الميزان هو الجهاز الذي يستخدم لقياس الوزن، وبالتالي فإن الاسم يوحي بالدقة والتوازن في حياة الشخص الذي يحمله. كما أن الميزان في القرآن الكريم يرمز إلى العدل الإلهي والمساواة.

in_urdu.name: مizanون
in_urdu.meaning: مشتق از میزان، مطلب عدل و توازن
in_urdu.long_meaning: مizanون ایک مشتق نام ہے جو میزان سے نکلا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہوتا ہے عدل اور توازن۔ اردو میں، میزان وہ آلہ ہے جو وزن ماپنے کے لیے استعمال ہوتا ہے، اس لیے یہ نام ان شخص کی زندگی میں توازن اور درستی کی طرف اشارہ کرتا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: मिज़ानुन
in_hindi.meaning: मिज़ान से लिया गया, न्याय और संतुलन का अर्थ
in_hindi.long_meaning: मिज़ानुन नाम मिज़ान से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है न्याय और संतुलन। हिंदी में, मिज़ान एक उपकरण है जिसका उपयोग वजन मापने के लिए किया जाता है, इसलिए यह नाम व्यक्ति के जीवन में संतुलन और सटीकता की ओर इशारा करता है।

in_english.name: Mizanun
in_english.meaning: Derived from Mizan, meaning justice and balance
in_english.long_meaning: Mizanun is a derived name from Mizan, which means justice and balance. In Arabic, Mizan is an instrument used to measure weight, thus the name suggests balance and accuracy in the life of the person who bears it. The term Mizan also appears in the Quran, symbolizing divine justice and equality.
